label: searchMovies.orama.hybridSearch
reason: The Orama hybrid `search()` is the dominant cost in this handler path; bumping `limit` from 1000 to 2000 can roughly double the amount of work (scoring, vector operations, materializing hits/vectors), increasing latency and memory pressure.

reason: With the higher search limit, downstream per-hit work scales up: mapping `vectorResult.hits` into candidates, Levenshtein reranking, and building the `hitById` map. This can become a significant portion of end-to-end latency as hit count grows.
